prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate one beautiful, high-fidelity desktop website homepage screenshot, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, for Jonathan Graydon's personal portfolio. Direction: Evidence in monochrome. Render an actual designed web UI viewport edge to edge, without browser chrome, external framing, annotations, moodboard panels, or poster conventions.
SURFACE STRUCTURE: 72px side margins and broad asymmetrical editorial grid. At top a slim floating clear liquid-glass navigation bar, JG identity at left, Home, Projects, Music, Resume at right. Glass has realistic tiny refractive edge distortion, subtle shadow and visible translucent layering. Hero starts below with a small accurate title 'Computer Science Student at McMaster University | Software Engineer'. Set 'Jonathan' and 'Graydon' as a tremendous two-line geometric sans headline on the left, bold, very tight thoughtful spacing, about 112px. At right aligned adjacent to name, show a large exquisitely framed project UI preview labeled 'RouteLab': a restrained software graph-routing workspace with small schematic route nodes and connections, slim controls and a tidy side panel, monochrome with a tiny periwinkle selected path. This preview is project evidence, not an unrelated abstract decoration; avoid numerical performance claims. Beneath the large name in a measured readable column, exact intro 'Computer Science student, software engineer, robotics programmer, and trumpet performer building polished digital and technical projects.' Under intro, clear black 'View Projects' button with a small northeast arrow and restrained outline 'View Resume' button. Beneath the hero is a thin hairline and two quiet navigation links 'Software & Robotics' and 'Music', each with a directional arrow. At lower viewport, begin a Featured work section with a 32px heading, small 'View all projects' link, and a wide asymmetric two-column project presentation, showing 'RouteLab' and 'Personal Portfolio Website', their sophisticated software-interface images partially extending below the viewport. Use real project names only.
VISUAL GRAMMAR: Warm near-white #f4f4ef ground, deep neutral ink #161819, only very sparing #5c6cff accent. Tight geometric sans akin Satoshi in only regular and bold weights. Beautiful optical alignment, carefully varied whitespace, clear hierarchy and exquisite restrained borders. Deliberate architectural spacing, solid confidence, neutral restraint. Use the software monochrome design canon as inspiration for exact typography, understated small UI chrome, neutral-scale framed product evidence, and hairline detail, never its subject matter or copy. Glass navigation is clear and subtle. Strong asymmetric editorial composition and broad whitespace. All text crisp and clean. UI should feel ready to implement and exceptionally polished.
CONSTRAINTS: No invented testimonials, metrics, availability statements, claims, commercial product copy, credentials, or projects. No dashboard analytics graphs, no stock photos, no invented people, no fake awards. This is a credible student/software engineer/robotics/trumpet portfolio with first viewport project evidence.
